mechanism_narrative: A sustained low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 4.5% signals tight labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing activity that reduces corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, INDPRO declines do not lead to negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for INDPRO signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5% (CPIAUCSL), it signals accelerating inflation that prompts monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates robust job growth that expands household income and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS YoY growth exceeds 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals reduced consumer confidence in housing, dampening overall demand and leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, HOUST declines do not lead to negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or Rank IC for HOUST decline signal falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production (INDPRO) and quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) signal broad economic slowdown that reduces corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining INDPRO and GDPC1 fails to produce negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
